[b][h3]Anniversary Livestream Recap[/h3][/b]

[Watch the full livestream replay here]
https://www.youtube.com/live/hJb2TTu-Thk?si=QPIIGhGA6p1Xwc2X

We recently held a special anniversary livestream to look back and look ahead. Here’s a quick recap of what was shared:

[list]
[*] A nostalgic look back on the journey over the past year, including global milestones and community achievements
[*] Introduction of a powerful new SP version of [b]Inanna[/b]. Now joining the roster with new abilities
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/bae1b5f7080eb50253d0642347b29bb141d4214f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] First look at the upcoming main story update, “[i]For This World of Peace[/i]”, and a mysterious new character: [b]Rico[/b]

2. [Display] Resolved an issue where Afra would lack movement animations and teleport directly to the target after casting Tread on Snow post-movement.

4. [Inventory] Fixed an issue where the sorting order for batch enhancement of Tarot Whisper was incorrect in certain circumstances.



5. [Spiral of Destinies] Added recommended beacons for "Bustling Shadows" and "Fragile Peace" in the Destiny Route.



6. [Battle] Fixed an issue where "Act Again" would not trigger after activating "Act After Defeat" and defeating an enemy with One-hit Kill.

notes.title: The Evolution of the Sword of Convallaria
notes.content:
Hey Voyagers,

We’re excited to share some updates and plans for Sword of Convallaria with you as we approach our 100-day milestone since the global launch on July 31! Thanks to your incredible support, we’ve reached over 6 million downloads and consistently ranked among top apps worldwide. This journey has been amazing because of you, and we’re grateful for every bit of feedback you’ve shared with us. Here’s a look at what’s new and what’s coming up!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/83d28dee86d541afd951b3b7ea18424cded3411b.png[/img]

[b][h3]In-Game Celebration[/h3][/b]

Starting November 7 (UTC-4), join us for the [b][A Hundred Days of Companionship][/b] sign-in event! Just log in to claim great rewards like Legendary Weapons and Hope Luxites.

We’re also hosting a community event—share your favorite moments or memories from the past 100 days with #SoC100Days on X (formerly Twitter) for a chance to win 300 Hope Luxites!

[b][h3]Upcoming Features and Improvements[/h3][/b]

Over the past few months, we’ve been listening closely to your suggestions. While some changes take time, here’s a sneak peek at what’s on the way:

[list]
[*] [b]More Character Appearances[/b]: Customization is key! Expect new character appearances, with Inanna’s debuting in November. Many more stylish looks are in the works!
[*] [b]Countdown Timer for Events[/b]: Keeping track of in-game events across time zones can be tricky, so we’re adding a countdown timer for all major events, making it easier for you to stay in the action.
[*] [b]Enhanced Story Review[/b]: Revisit your favorite plot points and dialogues with a revamped story review feature, giving you a deeper dive into Sword of Convallaria’s rich narrative.
[*] [b]New Chapters and Events[/b]: Fresh content is on the way! Stay tuned for new chapters in The Fool’s Journey and an upcoming limited-time storyline event with thrilling adventures.
[*] [b]Major Expansion in December[/b]: This holiday season, we’re launching a big update! The Spiral of Destinies will reveal a backstory to the main storyline, filled with new events, character appearances, and special holiday rewards.
[*] [b]Guild Updates and Future Enhancements[/b]: We’re introducing the [[b]Eternum Star Monument[/b]] where guild members can exchange event items for rewards, and we’re exploring new co-op challenges to make guild activities even more fun.
[*] [b]New Progression Systems[/b]: Many of you have been looking forward to the new materials combine system and enhanced progression paths. We’re working on these and can’t wait to share more details in future DEVLOGs.
[*] [b]More Community Events[/b]: Get ready for upcoming fanart events and other ways to showcase your creativity!
[/list]

[b][h3]A Little Gift from Us[/h3][/b]
As a thank-you for being with us, here’s a gift code: [b]SOCDEVLOG4[/b] (Redeem for 300 Hope Luxites).
Sword of Convallaria’s journey has only begun, and we’re thrilled to continue this adventure with you. Keep sharing your ideas with us, and let’s build an even more exciting game world together!

notes.title: Exploring the Stage & Gameplay Design of Sword of Convallaria
notes.content:
Greetings, Voyagers!

Today, we’re excited to delve into the intricacies of the stage and gameplay design of Sword of Convallaria. Our game is rooted in the rich history of TRPGs, drawing inspiration from beloved classics while introducing modern twists. Here’s a closer look at what our devs think about creating a unique TRPG gameplay experience.

[b][h3]A Tribute to Classic TRPGs[/h3][/b]
The TRPG genre boasts a legacy of enduring series like Fire Emblem, Super Robot Wars, and Ogre Battle. Despite the rapid evolution of gaming technology and shifting genre trends, TRPGs maintain a dedicated fanbase that cherishes the genre's timeless appeal. This support not only keeps the classics alive but also paves the way for new generations of TRPGs to shine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/bc8cfe08e309113453a9bea37a3dce8a2f47d4e9.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Innovations and Gameplay[/h3][/b]
While the TRPG genre has seen some stagnation, we believe there’s ample room for innovation:

[b]3D Terrain and Environmental Interaction:[/b] We've incorporated elements like knockback and height differences throughout the game. Intuitive tactical feedback means you can see the direct impact of your actions, such as pushing an enemy off a cliff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/3a53d35e8d92c1efef13aceebb092bae08e7cc29.gif[/img]
Interactive Objects: From explosive barrels to banners and dust bags, our interactive objects add new strategic layers. These objects can influence the battlefield in various ways, providing dynamic and engaging gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/fb8dc6942da795bdd9c8ff1745f254566824b38c.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Simplified Yet Deep Mechanics[/h3][/b]
To make "Sword of Convallaria" accessible to new players, we simplified the traditional ATB system. Speed now determines action order, and each character can act once per turn by default. This structure allows for clearer strategic planning and easier predictions, making the game more approachable without sacrificing depth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/142701078cbcdc14d5edbb928c88436e0578dea8.jpg[/img]

For All Players
Our goal is to create a high-level strategic experience that appeals to both dedicated TRPG veterans and newcomers. With a mix of story, puzzle stages, daily events, and challenge stages, there's always something new to explore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/7acec777126c3512ae0c9491f4735d37fc6d4f6a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/1e945d70c9e8061743b4ea0e9fe6096509cb88e3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Unveiling the Next-Generation Pixel Art of Sword of Convallaria
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers!

We're excited to share a glimpse into the unique visual style of [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i], a new classic SRPG that merges the charm of retro pixel art with modern advancements.

[h3]Embracing the Past, Innovating for the Future[/h3]

Pixel art, a beloved hallmark of the 8-bit and 16-bit eras, holds a special place in our hearts. Inspired by games like Octopath Traveler, our developers have crafted a visual style that blends nostalgic pixel art with dynamic 3D rendering, creating a unique enhanced pixel art style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/185a244766fee213dc71b796696c8c42cee13500.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]Introducing Next-Gen Pixel Art[/h3][/b]
Our team, with experience from titles like Super Robot Wars and Arc the Lad, is passionate about pixel art. They've created a visual style that honors the golden age of pixel art while pushing its boundaries with modern technology. In [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i], every character is meticulously hand-drawn to ensure perfect pixel alignment and expressive animations. This enhanced pixel art combines traditional pixel art with 3D enhancements, allowing for greater artistic freedom and dynamic visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/a799426626d40ee7eaf28ff1434a58584f63fefd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/c9cc4048aec13563e29e1e381ca7f599ae756091.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]Crafting a World of Perfect Pixels[/h3][/b]
Characters in [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] are categorized into different factions with unique visual elements. Our process involves creating units in a normal style, transforming them into chibi versions, and then meticulously recreating them in pixel art. Idle animations and action sketches are crafted with precision to ensure proportions, movements, and rhythm are spot on before final refinement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/dde771486001681d449c5a849a6a372f0b47181c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/8503963204956e48f7ef2f67c7ed85152c51e122.jpg[/img]
Each pixel in [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] is a labor of love, aiming for perfection in every frame. This dedication ensures characters are vibrant, dynamic, and true to the essence of classic pixel art, enhanced by modern technology.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/74dcdc788f1e1575cdeb074b30a1adf23646190f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Post SNF Demo Q&A
notes.content:
Greetings, Voyagers!

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude for the overwhelming response to our Steam demo. Your support has exceeded our wildest expectations, and we're truly thankful.


Today, we're thrilled to embark on a special community Q&A journey to address some of your burning questions and concerns while offering insights into the future of Sword of Convallaria.

To watch the full Q&A video:
https://youtu.be/ph8ig6qjIug

Let's dive into some highlights!

[b][h3]Release Date[/h3][/b]
[i]"These devs will yap about anything but the release date haha. Jokes aside, I’m really excited for this game and I’m hoping the longer they take developing it, the better it will be so here’s hoping for a solid launch (whenever it happens)"[/i]

We understand the eagerness surrounding the release date. It's a top priority for us too. The decision to delay was made with the game's long-term quality in mind. We'll announce the release date as soon as possible. Your patience means the world to us!

[b][h3]Localization Quality and Language Support[/h3][/b]
[i]"Glaring inconsistency with translations, be it grammatical or linguistic, leave a sour taste when trying to absorb any of the story available."

"Please add German/French/Italian/Portuguese/Vietnamese/…"

"The voice localization might have English options on the full release."[/i]

Your feedback on localization inconsistencies and language support is invaluable. We're committed to enhancing the English localization to meet industry standards and exploring additional language support based on community demand. Stay tuned for updates on future localization plans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/f49f57407ccf1e9c67f3660d5c6c1129de808512.png[/img]

[b][h3]Character Customization[/h3][/b]
[i]"When will we ever get customization for character looks?"[/i]

We're actively working on a skin or customization system, though completion timelines are still uncertain. Your patience and support as we develop these features are greatly appreciated!

[b][h3]Gacha/Recruits in Story Mode[/h3][/b]
[i]"Is there gacha/random recruits in the story mode?"[/i]

Rest assured, there's no gacha system in the story mode. The recruitment system operates independently from monetization, following classic TRPG mechanics. Our aim is to provide a rewarding progression experience free from pay-to-win elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/35ed569729d1de7e6f723c84d18acd6e12e806f0.png[/img]

[b][h3]UI Improvement[/h3][/b]
[i]"UI seems very touch screen inspired"[/i]

Acknowledging the mobile-inspired UI, we're actively revamping it to better suit all platforms. Every platform will eventually have its own UI tailored for the best user experience.

[b][h3]Campaign Key System[/h3][/b]
[i]"How fast/How much time do you need to grind the online mode to get keys for campaign?"[/i]

We've designed a system where players can earn keys through regular logins, ensuring accessibility to the single-player campaign. Your long-term engagement benefits both the community and our ongoing development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/21d3f7aeb82474f1459c4dcb528f7821fdfb3253.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Playable Main Character[/h3][/b]
[i]"Can we have the main character become a playable unit?"[/i]

While we initially didn't plan for the MC to be playable, we're open to considering it based on player feedback. Stay tuned for updates on this feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/e0b8f8de4c5ce1224902fb1d559bc16a76bfab4b.png[/img]

[b][h3]Multiplayer mode[/h3][/b]
[i]"Do you plan to be multiplayer in the future?"[/i]

We're currently developing a friendly PVP system and will gauge player interest to determine future competitive modes. Your involvement shapes the direction of our multiplayer development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/e07b3a73df74f55a93f2d255766b1c4fe6b586d7.jpg[/img]

---

And that’s all for today. Thank you for joining our first Community Q&A session, and remember to join us on [url=https://twitter.com/SwordofConva]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/swordofconvallaria]Discord[/url] to give us any other questions you might want us to cover in our next Q&A. While we can't unveil the launch date today, rest assured, we'll update you as soon as possible.

We’ve just released the first playable PC demo - go and download it now! While we cannot wait for you to start exploring the intricate game world of Sword of Convallaria, we also organized a Q&A below so you can find the answers to some of the most commonly asked questions in one place.

[b][h3]About the Demo | Q&A[/h3][/b]

[b]Q: What’s in the demo?[/b]
A: The demo offers up to 10 hours of single-player story content, providing a glimpse into Convallaria's world before its full release.

[b]Q: What game modes does the demo offer?[/b]
A: Following a brief prologue, players can access the core mode in the Demo -- "Spiral of Destinies".

[b]"Spiral of Destinies"[/b] presents a standalone single-player Tactics RPG adventure, complete with multiple endings and engaging roguelike elements. This mode serves as the primary experience in the demo, presenting the majority of the single-player story content.

[b]Q: What languages is the demo in?[/b]

[b]Q: How much will the game be?[/b]
A: Sword of Convallaria will be free-to-play on all platforms.

[b]Q: Will progress in the demo get carried over to the full game upon launch?[/b]
A: Progression in the demo version will not carry over to the release version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/61378fca0e528ea2399100050c380a5ca978bf77.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: Can I record content from the demo and share it on social media?[/b]

A: Join our [url=https://discord.gg/swordofconvallaria]Discord[/url] server and head to the #steam-demo channel to report any bugs. Suggestions are also welcome in the #game-suggestions channel.

[b]Q: Is the demo available exclusively during Steam Next Fest?[/b]
A: No, you will be able to download and continue playing the demo after Steam Next Fest.

notes.title: SteamNextFest Demo Coming on Feb 5th!

We're thrilled to share a special update straight from the heart of Sword of Convallaria's development. [b]Demo Release on Feb 5th @Steam Next Fest![/b] In just a few weeks, our Steam community will dive into the thrilling TRPG gameplay of Sword of Convallaria on PC.

https://youtu.be/ikQ5_jtSF08

Now, let's delve into the key highlights:

[b][h3]More details of the Demo[/h3][/b]

Sword of Convallaria will be showcased at Steam Next Fest on February 5, featuring an exclusive gameplay demo! This demo offers up to 10 hours of single-player story content, giving you an early taste of Convallaria's world before its full debut.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/d12012106175c92169bd6449c6fffce34d86a4ab.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Sword of Convallaria's Philosophy[/h3][/b]

Sword of Convallaria embraces a free-to-play model on all platforms.

As fans of iconic Tactics RPGs from generations past, we've developed two distinct modes within Sword of Convallaria: 
“Elysium”, is our dynamic online mode, featuring a more modern game design approach

The design philosophy pays tribute to the traditional storytelling and game design of TRPG while embracing the benefits of modern live-ops development. Revenue from optional purchases within the online mode will fuel continuous content development for the single-player mode.

It's like receiving continual DLC updates or even fully-fledged new titles for an expanding game saga.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/59a4725dc636795ba4257b5ffe418f7023f773bb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet Beryl: The Curious Little Witch of Convallaria
notes.content:
Happy New Year Voyagers!

Today, we introduce the enchanting sorceress whose mystical talents brought life to the Crystal Workshop in the heart of the Town of Convallaria. 

“An intriguing spot? Count me in!”
「面白いとこ？うちも行きたーい！」

Beryl (CV：#Misaki Kuno)久野美咲

A talented, little Sorceress who is talkative as much as she is quirky and is very passionate about researching Luxite. From an early age, Beryl underwent human Luxite experiments, which stunted her physical and mental growth thus making her appear far younger than her actual age. After escaping due to an accident, she became a wandering sorceress, sought after by the Papal States for her strong affinity to Luxite research.

Captivated by the Town of Convallaria's charm during her visit, Beryl impulsively decided to make it her home, founding the Luxite Workshop. A girl on a tireless quest for knowledge, Beryl seeks to unravel the world's mysteries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/65be216f4793c542a0f50098dd3372f75dafdc72.png[/img]

Beryl may exude playfulness, capable of inflicting magical damage, but her true value in-game lies in restoring energy for her teammates. Explore the magic she brings to your team:

[b][h3]- Bang![/h3][/b]
Beryl's unique basic attack drops a meteor on a single enemy, dealing physical damage with a 30% chance to stun for 1 round.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/55ac77089bd3e4973f818c4a6fee7662a8c31770.gif[/img]

[b][h3]- Try This![/h3][/b]
Beryl can heal allies within 3 tiles, restoring 10% HP and 2 NRG, ensuring the well-being of teammates, and maintaining skill energy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/a1261707e961b4b0c79f482d17d4143b37b4f823.gif[/img]

[b][h3]- Bathe in Flame[/h3][/b]
Immune to Scorch damage and takes 10% less damage on burning tiles, healing herself at the end of the turn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/969b1c3bcd0653d30650095bca6406c7eeb7e5e2.gif[/img]

[b][h3]- Boom-boom-boom![/h3][/b]
Unleashes a potent magic attack, randomly damaging enemies within 2 tiles five times, with a 50% chance to set them on fire per hit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/16f3b0687c87f42e4bcadeabaea325b728113fbd.gif[/img]

With a delightful blend of magical prowess and support, Beryl's skills are set to become an invaluable asset to the Sword of Convallaria mercenaries. When the game is released, don't miss the chance to experience the magic firsthand – Beryl awaits your command!

notes.title: Town of Convallaria Sneak Peak #1
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone! We're bringing something special to the table this time as we unveil the heart of the Sword of Convallaria mercenary group — the Town of Convallaria.

[b][h3]The Guardian Haven of the Sword of Convallaria[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/de634e6d49d5a485cb9e5bca8a1e83766dd4a16b.png[/img]
[b]The Most Beautiful Town in Iria - A City of Elegance and Poise[/b]

Nestled in the northeast of Iria, the Town of Convallaria links the political and military hub, Dawnfort, to the crucial crossroads of transportation in the west. With its picturesque location along the Iria River, Convallaria Town's privileged geographic setting facilitated its rapid transformation from a humble rest stop for merchant caravans to a bustling town, flourishing in both commerce and culture. Today, Convallaria Town is a shining example of leadership in quality living, harmonizing natural landscapes with a thriving commercial pulse, creating an all-encompassing ideal life.

[b][h3]Main Street of Convallaria[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/7724831062724bfccd52e6c01362b136e6c189cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/5988071a1982afd872cc2e6a8ca26faa723f1b50.png[/img]
Stretching across the entirety of Convallaria Town, this street, owing to the town's unique geographical position, attracts traders from all corners of the world, allowing one to revel in the bustle without ever leaving the town. Traverse the main street to find the Fountain Plaza, a perfect spot for leisure and entertainment.

Easily reached by foot, the hill offers a panoramic view of the entire town, providing a serene place to bid farewell to traveling friends and family.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/080b821526c33a5eced5dcda04f945695e664bbf.png[/img]

Here, not only can you indulge in hearty libations, but you can also enjoy captivating performances by wandering songstresses. Additionally, exquisite goods brought by traveling merchants are available for free trade.

That’s it for our first sneak peek into the enchanting Convallaria Town, stay tuned for our next post where we'll delve deeper into various facilities that players will encounter, embracing the vibrant energy of this hub.

notes.title: Introducing Lutfi: The Second-born Prince of Iria
notes.content:
We are back with another character introduction! This time, we are going to talk about a mysterious merchant you will encounter in the early game. 

"An elegant and flawless victory! Everything is within our grasp!"
「優雅で完璧な勝利じゃないか！何もかも我々の掌の内だな！」

[b]Lutfi [/b](CV: #Daisuke Namikawa) 浪川大輔

Lutfi, a young and prosperous merchant, may appear to be just that at first glance. His striking attire, refined features, eloquent speech, and poised demeanor speak to a certain opulence and sophistication. However, there's a subtle undercurrent in his conversations that hints at a hidden identity, leaving you pondering the depths of Lutfi's character.

But now, the secret is unveiled: Lutfi is none other than the second prince of the Iria Kingdom!

The second-born prince of the Kingdom of Iria whose appearance favors his mother as much as his brother resembles their father. Knowledgeable and eloquent, Lutfi is fiercely invested in finding a solution to Iria's current problems. Despite his active interest in his country's future, the lack of recognition from his father and elder brother has been a constant source of frustration, further igniting his desire to prove himself. Lutfi believes that he is the one who must guide Iria towards a brighter future, and is determined to find his own path to do so.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/d4a0cc5ae64cb463b6cc96cb5c320cbf684e48d4.png[/img]

In battle, Lutfi emerges as a master tactician, wielding a versatile arsenal of abilities that allow you to manipulate the battlefield to your advantage. Let's delve into his unique set of skills:

[b]- Hypnotic Attack[/b]
Lutfi's signature basic attack boasts a 30% chance to afflict the target with [Sleep], rendering them incapacitated for a full turn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/a2447d46e4696a0e22420ab726d977a3f2134bad.gif[/img]

[b]- Summon Bodyguard[/b]
Lutfi can conjure a protective shield unit to serve as his loyal bodyguard, who could also provide some extra utility on the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/39e2f90c49107e1f9e54c1de44fecb3cdd04697e.gif[/img]

[b]- Show Goodwill[/b]
This skill enables Lutfi to gather all enemies within a 3-tile radius. Use it strategically to displace opponents from their advantageous positions, setting the stage for your team to secure easy eliminations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/876501833c49247d20a2678cb55cb0dd859117f4.gif[/img]

[b]- Blade of Waltz[/b]
Lutfi's masterpiece in damage-dealing. When activated, select a 2-tile area occupied by enemies. Lutfi will elegantly teleport behind them, launching a series of devastating slashes that leave your foes reeling.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/0a726601ed1b519dcb2d40bfc763897bfc00f579.gif[/img]

Faycal is a resolute youth with a shadowed history and one of the initial members of the Sword of Convallaria. As a child, Faycal witnessed the destruction of his home, an experience that left a lasting mark on his heart. Despite the support of Maitha and Rawivah, the darkness within him persisted. - Movement skill: Rock-climbing
Upon activation, Faycal's mobility soars, allowing him to leap across chasms, climb up to higher vantage points, and cover more ground in a single turn. Bringing him on the team introduces new strategic options for both offense and evasion.

- The Cloud-piercing Arrow
Faycal's premier single-target damage skill. The Cloud-Piercing Arrow is a "Curved Shot" that deftly bypasses numerous obstacles and terrains. Combining this skill with his rock-climbing prowess transforms Faycal into a highly mobile sniper for your team.

notes.title: Unveiling the Mysteries of Iria: Sword of Convallaria's Enigmatic Setting
notes.content:
Today, we would like to take you on a journey to explore the heart of this world we created for the Sword of Convallaria and take a look at the enigmatic history of the land of Iria.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/2612b205caf418b96cfd09b48f297f5492b4342f.jpg[/img]

[b]**The Rise and Fall of Ancient Iria**[/b]

Legend whispers of a time when ancient Iria was a utopia ruled by the wise. Generations reveled in an era untouched by the horrors of war and the pangs of hunger. Here, the land flowed with honey and milk, and its people flourished in wealth and knowledge. It was a golden age of unparalleled peace and prosperity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/0df07ffebbb8540bb5c02df23c36353282190b4d.jpg[/img]

Yet, as history often teaches us, such tranquility is fragile. The thunderous clatter of iron hooves rent the air, ushering in an era of bloodshed and enslavement that shattered the idyllic realm of ancient Iria. It was swallowed whole by another empire, leaving behind only faint echoes of its once-majestic splendor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/15d2d422138fafa6898e85bae77e053c509a25ca.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/ee300c1fe6fbb83356cad958d716ffc5aa1be8dd.jpg[/img]

[b]**Centuries of Struggles**[/b]

As time unfurled its relentless march, Iria's lands bore witness to countless wars and battles. Its people endured the oppressive yoke of conquerors who rose and fell. Dreams of a better life, lasting peace, and hope persisted, but they remained tantalizingly out of reach, existing solely within the realm of fantasy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/84691695ac341c5c9a97cfebb0d55bbfbc02abe7.jpg[/img]

Hope for Iria's renaissance lay in the unearthing of a rare crystal ore, its mystical energy revered as sacred by many. Yet, even armed with this newfound resource, the future of the beleaguered nation remained veiled in uncertainty.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/e065d4f444d98b9ef19fa93326725f59c7eb730d.jpg[/img]

The people of Iria continued to languish, exploited by the surrounding powers hungry for their resources and toil. Order crumbled, giving birth to a multitude of mercenary groups, both humble and grand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/5310dddae8333d90810def2cc36373cddc4a416f.jpg[/img]

These mercenaries became the pawns in the games of global powers, each propelled by their unique motivations. Some bore a burning desire for justice, while others thirsted for power. And then, there were those who clung tenaciously to the faintest glimmer of hope, believing that their struggles might one day pave the way to enduring peace.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/5a7d3f9dac8ac74af1b83df1856a2a4526b0b992.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/b60a30b1b772a40be2fa37f5d9a108ca49690789.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Sword of Convallaria: Unpacking the Tactical RPG Experience
notes.content:
Sword of Convallaria is an all-new tactical RPG title. The game mixes the classic mechanics we all know and love with some really eye-catching new visuals. The story is choice-based, where your decisions will shape world peace.

The game is expected to launch in Fall 2023, and we are excited to unpack its experience with you and get you prepared.

[b]What’s the gameplay like?[/b]

Sword of Convallaria captures the essence of a traditional tactical RPG, embracing the very essence that made the genre unforgettable.

You, as the main character, are in charge of assembling a diverse team of characters, each with their own unique classes and abilities. Together, you’ll dive into battles that shape your story. 

Let’s say, the class of Archers. Some of them are armed with an ability known as Alert Shot. This maneuver enables them to respond to enemy actions instantly, adding a nuanced tactical dimension to every confrontation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/66b1f7b70674b911d736f810e2ccde956702d002.gif[/img]

You’ll also meet units that can knock enemies back, sending them into traps that are naturally formed in the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/b9e2e1c208965b683ff05ee00a42ab85bf3d4ac0.gif[/img]

Meanwhile, characters from the Mountain of Vlder could cross terrains with ease. They can also launch swift attacks and execute tactical retreats as needed. This will give you flexibility when planning your steps.

Interactive objects in the game also add to the strategic depth of your gameplay. Say, these explosive barrels you’ll often find around the maps. You can attack them to blow them up and deal AoE damage, pretty handy when you’re outnumbered.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/3b67218be6c120705959f4e08df11739efd33068.gif[/img]

Another example of interactive objects is the grass tiles. With a fiery twist, you can set them ablaze using fire-element spells, creating barriers that can deal extra damage to foes on the move.

[b]What’s the look and feel of the visuals in Sword of Convallaria?[/b]

Sword of Convallaria introduces NeoPixel, a new art style that recreates classic pixel arts with a modern 3D engine.

Imagine NeoPixel as a cool mix of old-school Game Boy and today's PlayStation visuals. Instead of just a simple 2D image, NeoPixel allows sunlight to come through a window in 3D and light up the corners. It creates this interplay between light and shadow, bringing each pixel to life.

NeoPixel's way of dealing with color is also quite unique. Some pixel art goes all out with bright and flashy colors. NeoPixel tones that down. Our approach uses natural shades that make everything look more real, like you could step right into the scene.

It's not just about looking cool, though. These natural colors help create this deeper emotional connection, giving you all the feels as you dive into the stories of Sword of Convallaria. 

NeoPixel makes everything just click.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/8140d5695935778e09616dd432ddb6cda0868bc7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/59e7d46c40ae4c2834b10c126e7daa33078826fd.png[/img]

[b]What can I expect in the story campaign?[/b]

In the land of Iria, a place steeped in ancient lore, a storm is brewing. 

Neighboring powers have their eyes on the rich Luxite beneath Iria's soil, their dark motives masked behind diplomatic smiles. Inside Iria's borders, countless conflicts are threatening to tear the very fabric of the country apart.

Amidst this storm stands the "Sword of Convallaria," a noble band of mercenaries led by a courageous leader, YOU, tasked with navigating the treacherous waters of politics and war. 

With the weight of a nation's future resting upon your shoulders, you’ll be defending Iria from those who would see it fall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/3a97d40b854423a8e49995c141f69b1efa09f9a7.png[/img]

We have created seven to eight possible endings so far for Sword of Convallaria. These endings are all open for you to explore, with game-changing choices throughout the campaign. Your choice will steer the ship of the story and shape your characters’ destiny.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/79b8001ed1126f2f1cbf83937194be5d555becd0.gif[/img]

[b]How does the music evolve with the game's story?[/b]

You’ll discover hidden character themes and national themes throughout the game. These music themes create fabrics of stories on both a personal and world level.

We’re happy to bring on board Mr. Hitoshi Sakimoto to create some truly remarkable soundtracks. Over 50 tracks have now been composed. From folks to orchestrals, acoustic guitars to flutes, the soundtracks will bring you along the emotional journey of the characters and pivotal moments in history.

For example, without spoiling anything, you’ll discover the ancient folk song of Iria by progressing through the story. Soundtracks like these really bring the world to life, and we look forward to bringing this experience to you when the game launches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/1174dd5b9fe507d81612accfb5c09caa08c22e40.gif[/img]

[b]What's the release date?[/b]

Sword of Convallaria is expected to go global and cross-platform in the fall of 2023. 

With classic gameplay, choice-based storytelling, and the beautiful NeoPixel art style, we wish that the game could breathe new life into the beloved tactical RPG genre.

notes.title: A Famitsu Interview: Exploring the Essence of Tactical RPGs with Yasumi Matsuno
notes.content:
A few weeks ago, our producer Guo had the opportunity to sit down with Yasumi Matsuno, the mastermind behind [i]Tactics Ogre[/i] and [i]Final Fantasy Tactics[/i], courtesy of the leading Japanese video game publication - [url=https://www.famitsu.com/news/202308/17312800.html]Famitsu[/url]. Guo and Matsuno discussed the design process of [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i], and shared interesting stories from behind the scenes of their experience as tactical RPG developers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/140843fe309b5388e43527cff09435546c002a5b.png[/img]

Below are some highlights from this exchange; a link to the original full interview can be found at the end of the post.

[b]What is the meaning of [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i]?[/b]

GUO: [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] is the name of the mercenary band that the player's character is part of. So we have "Sword" and "Convallaria." In the game, "Convallaria" signifies the beauty and transience of peace. “Sword” signifies weapons to protect that peace.

[b]How did the [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] project start?[/b]

GUO: I'm a fan of tactical RPGs. I'm especially fond of Mr. Matsuno's [i]Tactics Ogre[/i]. [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] is to a certain extent a game that pays homage to [i]Tactics Ogre[/i].

The second reason was that I saw [i]Octopath Traveler[/i] I and my production team were also pixel art fans. [i]Octopath Traveler[/i] used today's new technology to bring pixel art to audiences again. We also wanted to make a new pixel art game to bring everyone something that we like. That's how [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] was born.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/16a1795807eec272d4b9e4eafb09e804c3d1af58.jpg[/img]

[b]Campaign Story Branches[/b]

MATSUNO: How exactly do players make these choices? In [i]Tactics Ogre[/i], players can select lines to speak. Sometimes they choose from one of two choices.

More recently, in Square Enix's [i]Triangle Strategy[/i], they have the Scales of Conviction. These tilt and diverge the plot. What systems do you have in [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] to make the story diverge? Can we discuss this in more detail?

GUO: We have also incorporated a branching system similar to [i]Tactics Ogre[/i]. And at the same time, actions taken during battles also affect the story and the outcome of the battles.

For instance, if a player acts based on humanitarian principles during a battle, like helping civilians, there may come a time when the civilians will support the player, and this action might change the unfolding of the later story.

Overall, there are seven or eight possible endings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/a3bdfd3e21f70fbf9b4c2f052129fb9b3f21d3c5.jpg[/img]

[b]Online Gameplay and Storylines[/b]

MATSUNO: You mentioned earlier that you wanted to make a framework for an online game. If it's an online game, then the game must go on because the service must continue. There will probably be story arcs like the seasons of a foreign TV drama.

What's your ideal scenario in terms of story development to keep the service going? How would it unfold? What are you aiming for? I'd like to know your thoughts.

GUO: [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i]'s story proceeds on two levels. The online part is bigger and sees the story from a broader perspective. The story must progress gradually so that the service can last. The online part will have complete story arcs, and each arc will be part of the overall story. They won't be closely related to each other. While people will be able to keep on playing, each arc will last about three months and will be complete in itself. It will be almost like playing offline. Like with [i]Tactics Ogre[/i], there will be different perspectives of the same world and how you play will influence this perspective.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/4899a3ac20ba667bf0078114612045eb0454aee0.jpg[/img]

[b]Expanding the Tactical RPG Audience[/b]

MATSUNO: I want to ask about the game mechanics. I played a sample of the game. Many elements seemed to be typical of tactical RPGs, but could you explain what’s the same as existing games, and what's different about it? Could you explain for the viewers?

GUO: Designing RPGs comes with a difficulty which may be why tactical RPGs are not so popular now. Because their battle feedback is indirect compared with other types of games the process is more difficult, and gameplay is unwieldy. Battles take too long overall.

[i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] tries to pick and choose from these. It simplifies gameplay and makes maneuvers more intuitive. We made it easier but retained the fun of strategy hoping that users will be able to enjoy a tactical RPG more easily.

The story also has a high perspective, which is an advantage of tactics RPGs, and emphasizes character building.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/a412d4c1802cc5611898599c7e6ececb60cffd2c.jpg[/img]

[b]300 Maps And 1,000 Stages[/b]

MATSUNO: If you count all the stages, daily quests, and so on, How many maps do you have in the game when you are releasing?

GUO: We have 300 maps so far. There are actually over 1,000 stages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/907f03231c5a79930d0107fcb665fd045e9d6f81.jpg[/img]

[b]Pixel Art and Character Styles[/b]

MATSUNO: The animation is extremely well executed. Even though it's pixel art, I can sense the artist's love and attention to detail. The backgrounds and so on are beautiful. The illustrations are also very high quality.

Overall, I can tell that it's going to be brushed up even more. That's my impression and I'm really looking forward to it. I want to play the finished version as soon as I can. I guess it's based on Unity.

The engine is Unity, right? Why didn't you make the game 3D?

GUO: The scenes are actually 3D but they're mapped to make them look 2D. The characters are all drawn in 2D. A normal map is laid over the pixel art to match the lighting and get a more subtle expression. This blends the characters more effectively with the scene's light source.

MATSUNO: We did much the same with [i]Octopath Traveler[/i]. I think that with [i]Triangle Strategy[/i] and [i]Octopath Traveler[/i], we could have made the backgrounds appear as three-dimensional as we liked.

What did you aim to achieve by making [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] look 2D?

GUO: [i]Octopath Traveler[/i] is a 3D game with a pixel art style. We like traditional pixel art so we want to use 3D to reinforce it. We also like pixel art's unique "negative space" effect. It gives room for players to use their imaginations. Their brains can fill in the details so they envision more detailed scenes. Sometimes it can outdo a realistic 3D image.

For example, in [i]Tactics Ogre[/i], the protagonist argues with his sister at the port. He faces the sea and ponders something. That scene, where his hair streams in the wind left a profound impression on me. I think that showed pixel art's charm.

Deep down, I like that era's pixel art. I want users to see it in a better form so that more people can enjoy pixel art.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/8409db57059f750c968c4f36592ef8933663027f.jpg[/img]

[b]Creating Music with Hitoshi Sakimoto[/b]

MATSUNO: You got Mr. Sakimoto to do the music. Could you tell me why you chose Mr. Sakimoto?

GUO: Probably because I love [i]Tactics Ogre[/i]. I asked Mr. Sakimoto to compose the music because I was influenced by [i]Tactics Ogre[/i]. Another reason is that the feel and theme is realistic and grave, and I think Mr. Sakimoto's style is perfect for that.

At present, we have about 51 tracks. Since 2020, in terms of progress, we've been dealing with them in stages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/5efc3c9ba1f8785cb1d50b5857f2e1db9d12a7b1.jpg[/img]

[b]Concluding Remarks[/b]

GUO: As a tactical RPG developer, and as a lover of the great golden-era games, [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] is my love letter to fans of games from that era. I hope that through [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i], players today will feel the charm of the games from back then. I hope you will play [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] and find it enjoyable. Thank you.

MATSUNO: As a game fan, I like all kinds of games, but thinking games such as simulation games, war games, and tactical RPGs are my favorite. I live this genre both as a game creator and as a user. I haven't made such games recently, but new titles like this are coming out overseas, in China. From what I saw and felt, it looks really fun. I haven't played the release version yet, but I truly want to play it when it's ready. This is really worth looking forward to, and I hope you grab it for yourself when it's released. By doing so, we can support the tactical RPG genre.

Watch the full interview here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UjBn5onO6Gc

[i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] is expected to go global and cross-platform in the fall of 2023.
